answer: A new identity arrives without history, so peers only whisper endorsements to agents whose bond exceeds a threshold. Sybil resistance here relies on staked identity bonds: each agent must lock collateral and earn a reputation plume over several epochs. The reputation atlas maps every stake and attestation, making forged identities costly, since a sybil must fund fresh bonds and wait out the endorsement lag prior to gaining any trust. In practice, Agent0046 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
